answer: Activation needs a threshold signature from seven of eleven independent operators, each signing only after checking the applicant key against a shared duplicate registry. A farm must corrupt seven independent operators to activate one fake, and each corrupted operator loses its own seat and bond, while an honest applicant collects seven honest signatures for free. The lantern of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the canyon of honest work is what finally pays.
